Collapsing must give the snapshot's verdicts exactly, with one deliberate exception: C4. The snapshot's 25 repeated case rows are an amber duplicate there and expand to identical comment rows here, where case uniqueness still holds after collapsing, so C4 passes. Named in comments_differ_from_snapshot so the exception has to be stated rather than discovered. Row and comment counts live in generation_stats.json.

C4 judges cases, and these rows collapse to the same 5,083 clean cases, so it passes. The rows are still dropped, still reported in what was read, and still raise a caution on anything read from comment text or counts.
